sample_unit: video recordings of laypersons' CPR skill tests

links.outcome: Standalone GPT-4o vs expert agreement and sensitivity/specificity on CPR compression metrics
links.effect: Poor agreement for compression depth (AC1 = 0.374) and recoil (AC1 = 0.355); GPT-4o sensitivity 35.6-40.6%, specificity 69.2-76.1%; experts sensitivity 77.8-84.3%, specificity 24.6-47.8%.
links.quote: However, the agreement was poor for the compression depth (AC1 = 0.374) and full chest recoil (AC1 = 0.355).

unlisted_practices: Using multimodal AI as a second reader to complement human evaluators and mitigate expert leniency bias in CPR skill assessment

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4o's performance on assessing video-recorded CPR skills compared to human expert evaluators and manikin sensors; it does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
